svg.aria-label: Riven TV — A calm, ad-free home screen for Android TV and Google TV, with Riven's own Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, sound and display screens and remote-button shortcuts. Runs on a 2019 Android TV 8 set. WallLoop — Live video wallpapers for macOS from your own videos: muted, hardware-decoded and quiet, living in the menu bar. Free and open source.
